faqs.question: What is StudentHub?
faqs.answer: StudentHub is a centralized student portal that provides access to academic information, campus events, notices, and student services in one place.

faqs.question: Who can access StudentHub?
faqs.answer: All registered students can access the portal. Public pages like Home, About, Events, Notices, FAQ, and Contact are accessible to everyone.

faqs.question: How do I register for an account?
faqs.answer: Click on the Register link in the navigation menu and fill out the registration form with your details. You will need your student ID and valid email address.

faqs.question: I forgot my password. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Use the Forgot Password link on the login page to reset your password. You will receive reset instructions via email.

faqs.question: How do I view my courses?
faqs.answer: After logging in, go to the Dashboard and click on Courses in the sidebar navigation to view your current courses.

faqs.question: Where can I check my attendance?
faqs.answer: Attendance records are available in the Attendance section of your student dashboard after logging in.

faqs.question: How do I access exam timetables?
faqs.answer: Exam timetables are posted in the Notices section under Academic Notices and are also available in your dashboard during exam periods.

faqs.question: Is StudentHub mobile-friendly?
faqs.answer: Yes, StudentHub is designed with responsive layouts that work on mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.

faqs.question: How do I report a technical issue?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact form or the Feedback section in your dashboard to report technical issues to the support team.

faqs.question: Can I update my profile information?
faqs.answer: Yes, go to Profile in your dashboard sidebar and click the Edit Profile button to update your personal and contact information.

faqs.question: How do I submit feedback?
faqs.answer: Navigate to the Feedback section in your dashboard, fill out the feedback form with category, subject, rating, and detailed message, then submit.

faqs.question: What are the notification settings?
faqs.answer: In Settings > Notification Settings, you can choose which email and SMS notifications you want to receive for grades, attendance, events, and notices.

faqs.question: How do I register for events?
faqs.answer: Browse the Events page, click View Details on any event, and follow the registration link. Some events may require admin approval.

faqs.question: Where can I find my grades?
faqs.answer: Grades are available in the Courses section of your dashboard. Click on a course to view detailed assessment results.

faqs.question: How do I contact the admin office?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact page for general inquiries. For urgent matters, call the office at +91 22 4567 8900 or visit Student Services Building, Room 204.

faqs.question: What is the minimum attendance requirement?
faqs.answer: Students must maintain at least 75% attendance in each course to be eligible for examinations. Automated alerts are sent when attendance falls below 80%.

faqs.question: How do I apply for leave?
faqs.answer: Medical and approved leaves are counted separately. Submit leave applications through the student services portal with supporting documents.

faqs.question: Can I change my course or specialization?
faqs.answer: Course changes are allowed within the first two weeks of the semester. Contact the academic office with your request and get approval from both department heads.

faqs.question: How do I access library resources?
faqs.answer: Library catalog, e-books, and databases are accessible through the Library link in Student Services on the home page. Use your student credentials to log in.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted for fees?
faqs.answer: Online payment portal accepts credit/debit cards, net banking, UPI, and wallet payments. Fee receipts are generated automatically after successful payment.
